solution: Disabled the batch flag and restarted the workers. Move the month-end batch to its own scheduled job. Read orders in pages of 1,000 in the batch.
trigger: Month-end report batch ran inside orders-worker and loaded every order of the month into memory
problem_statement: orders-worker pods were killed with "orders-worker container killed: OOMKilled (exit code 137)" every few minutes.
impact_description: Each restart paused the consumer group and order confirmations backed up. Workers hit their 512Mi limit and were killed again and again.
immediate_resolution: Disabled the batch flag and restarted the workers.

timeline.event: Month-end batch started inside orders-worker. None.
Alert OrdersWorkerOOMKilled fired. On-call restarted the workers.
Workers killed again within minutes of each restart. Paged the orders team.
Orders team found the batch loading the whole month into memory. Disabled the batch flag and restarted the workers.
timeline.action: Disabled the batch flag and restarted the workers

timeline.event: Workers stable and the backlog cleared. Closed the incident.

root_causes: The month-end batch loaded all orders of the month into worker memory at once.
The batch ran inside orders-worker, so its memory use killed the order consumer too.

action_items.action: Move the month-end batch to its own scheduled job.
Read orders in pages of 1,000 in the batch.
Stop orders-worker from being killed for memory and get orders flowing again.
